title: 대한민국학술원 및 대한민국예술원의 회원수당 지급 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 대한민국학술원 및 대한민국예술원의 회원수당 지급 규정
full_text:
Article 2 (Types and Scope of Allowances)
(1) Members of the Academy of Sciences and the Academy of Arts (hereinafter referred to as "members") shall be paid a fixed allowance of 2,000,000 won per month. <Amended on February 12, 1990; August 22, 1992; December 31, 1994; December 31, 1996; July 7, 2001; August 24, 2006; January 13, 2012; and September 3, 2024.>
(2) Where a member attends and participates in meetings of the Academy of Sciences or Academy of Arts or performs research or other work for either Academy, allowances may be paid within budgetary limits, as determined by the Minister of Education or the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism. <Amended on January 3, 1990; February 1, 1991; March 6, 1993; January 29, 2001; July 7, 2001; February 29, 2008; and March 23, 2013.>
(3) The presidents and vice presidents of the Academy of Sciences and Academy of Arts shall be paid monthly position allowances within budgetary limits, as determined by the Minister of Education or the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism. <Amended on January 3, 1990; February 1, 1991; March 6, 1993; January 29, 1996; January 29, 2001; July 7, 2001; February 29, 2008; and March 23, 2013.>
